question: Should this issue remain the broad memory-management consistency tracker while role-slot and Memory MVP issues handle slices, or should maintainers narrow it to a specific memory config/API contract now?
rationale: The remaining work changes public memory config, plugin ownership, doctor migration, docs, and memory lifecycle semantics; automation can verify the split but cannot choose the product contract.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until role-slot, backend, flush, and operator-surface contracts converge.

options.title: Narrow To Role Slots
options.body: Declare https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 the canonical architecture path and reduce this issue to remaining backend/flush gaps.

options.title: Define memory.type
options.body: Sponsor a smaller config design around builtin-only, qmd-only, and mixed modes, accepting that it may not solve plugin role ownership by itself.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until role-slot, backend, flush, and operator-surface contracts converge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-flush ownership and the issue's public config/API scope make this the strongest sampled product-direction owner.
